description: This file contains a class 'ColumnLikeLegendRenderer' which is responsible for rendering chart legends for certain chart types like column, line, or bar within the PDFsharp library. It initializes legend rendering information based on chart data and styling properties.

classes.name: ColumnLikeLegendRenderer
classes.description: A specialized renderer for chart legends corresponding to column-like chart series, such as stacked or regular columns, lines, or bars.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes and constructs the legend renderer info object, including font, color, border, and legend entries based on chart series data.
